patterns.name: Confused Deputy via Cross-Account AssumeRole

mitre_attack.technique_name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Temporary Elevated Cloud Access

patterns.description: A trust policy permits a third-party AWS account to assume a role without requiring sts:ExternalId, allowing any caller who learns the role ARN to assume it on behalf of the trusted service.
conditions: trust_policy.Principal.AWS is an external account ID
role.attached_policies includes at least one policy with Action: '*' or iam:*
indicators: Role ARN referenced in public documentation or marketing material
AssumeRole calls originating from IP ranges outside the trusted vendor's published CIDR list

patterns.name: iam:PassRole + lambda:CreateFunction Escalation
patterns.description: A principal holding iam:PassRole on a highly-privileged role combined with lambda:CreateFunction and lambda:InvokeFunction can create a function that assumes the privileged role, executing arbitrary code under elevated permissions.
conditions: passable_role.attached_policies includes AdministratorAccess OR equivalent wildcard policy
indicators: No service-linked role restriction on lambda:CreateFunction
CloudTrail shows CreateFunction immediately followed by Invoke from a low-privilege identity

patterns.name: Wildcard Resource in Trust Policy
patterns.description: A role's trust policy uses a wildcard principal (Principal: '*') or an overly broad federated principal, allowing unintended identities to assume the role.
conditions: trust_policy.Principal == '*' OR trust_policy.Principal.Federated matches broad OIDC wildcard
indicators: AssumeRole attempts from previously unseen account IDs
Role has not been scoped with aws:PrincipalOrgID or aws:SourceAccount

patterns.name: Excessive AssumeRole Chain Depth

mitre_attack.technique_name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token

patterns.description: A chain of role assumptions exceeds the organization's configured depth threshold (default 3), often used to obscure the original caller identity from audit trails.
conditions: each hop in the chain is a distinct role
indicators: Final role in chain has materially higher privilege than the originating identity

patterns.name: GCP Service Account Impersonation Chain
patterns.description: An identity holds roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on a service account that, in turn, holds elevated project-level roles, enabling impersonation-based privilege escalation.
indicators: generateAccessToken calls in Cloud Audit Logs from non-service identities

patterns.name: Azure Managed Identity Federation Abuse
patterns.description: A user-assigned managed identity is federated to an external workload identity (e.g. GitHub Actions OIDC) with an overly permissive subject claim, allowing any workflow in the repository to assume the identity's Azure RBAC roles.
conditions: federated_credential.subject matches broad wildcard pattern (e.g. repo:org/*)
managed_identity.role_assignments includes Owner OR Contributor at subscription scope
indicators: Federated credential subject lacks branch or environment qualifier
Sign-ins from GitHub Actions IP ranges assuming subscription-level roles

patterns.name: Kubernetes ServiceAccount Token Mounted with cluster-admin Binding
patterns.description: A pod's ServiceAccount is bound to the cluster-admin ClusterRole via a ClusterRoleBinding while automountServiceAccountToken is enabled, granting any process inside the pod full cluster control if compromised.
conditions: serviceaccount is not in a system namespace (kube-system, kube-public)
indicators: Workload namespace mismatched with cluster-admin scope
kubectl exec or token exfiltration events from the affected pod

patterns.name: Stale Cross-Account Trust to Decommissioned Account
patterns.description: A trust policy still references an external account ID that has been decommissioned or reassigned, creating a window for account-takeover-based privilege escalation if the account ID is reused.
indicators: No recent AssumeRole activity from the referenced account
Account ID absent from the organization's active account inventory
